headline: 3 injured in Gandaria shooting during street clash
summary: A woman and two men were shot in Dhaka's Swamibagh area on Sunday evening during a sudden fight on the road.
details: Three people were injured in gunfire at Munsirtek in Dhaka's Swamibagh area on Sunday evening. The victims were identified as Mohammad Siam, 22, Alamgir Hossain, 32, and Asha Akter, 28.
Siam, a resident of Jatrabari who works at a local hotel, reported being shot in the right shoulder while pulling down the shutter of his shop during the clash.
Alamgir Hossain, who runs a tea stall, was shot in the middle of his forehead while inside his shop as gunfire broke out in front of it.
Asha Akter, a homemaker, was caught in the crossfire while walking along the road and sustained a bullet wound to her right thigh.
All three injured individuals were taken to Dhaka Medical College Hospital for treatment, according to Mohammad Faruk, in-charge of the DMCH police outpost.
caption:
A sudden street fight in Dhaka's Gandaria area left three people, including a woman, shot and injured.

Three people were injured in gunfire at Munsirtek in Dhaka's Swamibagh area on Sunday evening. The victims were identified as Mohammad Siam, 22, Alamgir Hossain, 32, and Asha Akter, 28.

Siam, a resident of Jatrabari who works at a local hotel, reported being shot in the right shoulder while pulling down the shutter of his shop during the clash.

Alamgir Hossain, who runs a tea stall, was shot in the middle of his forehead while inside his shop as gunfire broke out in front of it.

Asha Akter, a homemaker, was caught in the crossfire while walking along the road and sustained a bullet wound to her right thigh.

All three injured individuals were taken to Dhaka Medical College Hospital for treatment, according to Mohammad Faruk, in-charge of the DMCH police outpost.

Source: Dhaka Tribune, The Daily Star, Jamuna TV, Prothom Alo

headline_marked: DU teacher [[files GD over leaked personal data]] and threats
headline: DU teacher files GD over leaked personal data and threats
summary: Assistant Professor Shehrin Amin Bhuiyan reports the unauthorized sharing of her phone number, email, and home address on Facebook.
details: Assistant Professor Shehrin Amin Bhuiyan (Monami) of the Department of Public Administration at Dhaka University has filed a General Diary (GD) at Shahbagh Police Station.
The teacher reported that her personal and sensitive information, including her mobile number, email address, and home address, were posted on Facebook without her permission.
Following the leak, she has been receiving threatening calls and abusive language from unknown numbers.
Due to her home address being made public, she now feels unsafe staying at her own residence.
Shahbagh Police Station OC Mo. Moniruzzaman confirmed the GD and stated that an investigation has begun to identify the individuals involved.
The police further noted that the GD would be transferred to the Detective Branch (DB) for further action.
